# Tags

Every declared tag, by category, with what it is. A tag's first level is its category; a tag covers the tags under it. How tags work, how to add one and how to rename one: [the tags README](../../assets/scripts/tags/README.md). The design: [TAG_SPEC.md](TAG_SPEC.md).

Declared in: `assets/scripts/resources/tag_declarations.tres`.

## `ability`

What an ability is: its category and groups. Lockouts, cancels and the AI's action lookup go by these.

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `ability.combat` | Fighting. | `combat` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combat.evade` | Getting out of an attack's way. | `combat.evade` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combat.knockback` | Being knocked back by a hit: the pawn's stagger. | `combat.knockback` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combat.melee` | A close-range attack: a swing or a thrust. | `combat.melee` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combat.parry` | Turning an attack aside. | `combat.parry` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combat.ranged` | An attack that fires a projectile or a hitscan shot. | `combat.ranged` |
| `ability.combo` | Steps of a combo: each step boosts the next, so the next press picks it. | `combo` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combo.finisher` | A combo's finishing swing. | `combo.finisher` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.combo.second` | A combo's second swing. | `combo.second` |
| `ability.death` | Dying: the ability that plays out a pawn's death. |  |
| `ability.movement` | Moving the pawn. | `movement` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.advanced` | A group: dash, and later a grappling hook. | `movement.advanced` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.basic` | A group: walk, sprint and jump. | `movement.basic` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.dash` | A quick burst of movement. | `movement.dash` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.jump` | Jumping. | `movement.jump` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.sprint` | Sprinting. | `movement.sprint` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.movement.walk` | Walking. | `movement.walk` |
| `ability.utility` | Doing something other than moving or fighting. | `utility` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.utility.heal` | Healing. | `utility.heal` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ability.utility.interact` | Using something in the world: a door, a lever, an item. | `utility.interact` |

## `ai`

The AI's own tags: its states and stances.

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `ai.stance` | How a behaviour fights: the AI's fighting styles, which score modifiers can favour. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ai.stance.melee` | Fighting up close: closing in to swing. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ai.stance.ranged` | Fighting from a distance: keeping away and shooting. |  |
| `ai.state` | The AI's state: what situation it thinks it is in. A pawn owns one while its AI runs. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ai.state.alert` | Something caught its attention, but it isn't sure of a target yet. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ai.state.combat` | It has a target it is sure of, and fights. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`ai.state.idle` | Nothing has its attention. |  |

## `effect`

What an effect is. Resistances, immunities and removing effects by kind go by these.

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `effect.buff` | A helpful effect. | `buff` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.buff.combo` | A combo step's boost to the next swing. | `buff.combo` |
| `effect.damage` | Damage of any kind. | `damage` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.damage.elemental` | Elemental damage of any kind. | `damage.elemental` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.damage.elemental.fire` | Fire damage. | `damage.elemental.fire` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.damage.elemental.frost` | Frost damage. | `damage.elemental.frost` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.damage.physical` | Physical damage: blades, blunt hits, bolts. | `damage.physical` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.damage.poison` | Poison damage. | `damage.poison` |
| `effect.debuff` | A harmful effect other than damage. | `debuff` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`effect.debuff.slow` | Slowing the pawn down. | `debuff.slow` |
| `effect.heal` | Restoring health. | `heal` |

## `event`

What happened to an entity: gameplay events, sent with Pawn.send_event and a payload (GameplayEventData).

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `event.damage` | Damage happened. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`event.damage.taken` | The pawn lost Health to an effect; the payload has the source and the amount. |  |
| `event.health` | The pawn's Health crossed a threshold. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`event.health.depleted` | Health reached 0: Death starts. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`event.health.low` | Health fell to a quarter of its max or below. |  |

## `nav`

Navigation: what a place, link or marker is, so pawns and the AI can find and use it.

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `nav.area` | A kind of ground (a nav modifier volume); each kind of agent has its own cost for it. | `area` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.area.forbidden` | Ground pawns don't enter. | `area.forbidden` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.area.hazard` | Dangerous ground. | `area.hazard` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.area.road` | A road. | `area.road` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.area.water` | Water. | `area.water` |
| `nav.link` | A connection between two places, crossed with an action. | `link` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.link.climb` | Crossed by climbing: a ladder or a wall. | `link.climb` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.link.door` | A door. | `link.door` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.link.jump` | Crossed by jumping: a gap or a ledge. | `link.jump` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.link.teleport` | A teleporter. | `link.teleport` |
| `nav.obstacle` | Something in the way that moves or can be moved (a dynamic obstacle). | `obstacle` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.obstacle.crate` | A crate. | `obstacle.crate` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.obstacle.vehicle` | A vehicle. | `obstacle.vehicle` |
| `nav.point` | A tactical point: a spot the AI goes to for a reason. | `point` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.point.ambush` | A spot to wait in ambush. | `point.ambush` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.point.cover` | Cover from attacks. | `point.cover` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.point.patrol` | A stop on a patrol route. | `point.patrol` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.point.wander` | A spot to wander to. | `point.wander` |
| `nav.use` | A smart object: something pawns use in place, a few at a time. | `use` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.use.pickup` | Something to pick up. | `use.pickup` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.use.seat` | A seat. | `use.seat` |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`nav.use.work` | A place to work: a forge, a desk, a field. | `use.work` |

## `status`

A condition a pawn is in right now.

| Tag | What it is | Old names |
|---|---|---|
| `status.dead` | The pawn is dead. |  |
| `status.has_ammo` | An ability with limited uses has some left. |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;`status.has_ammo.ranged` | A ranged attack has shots left. |  |
